content: संभवः .²1 Birth, production, springing up, arising, existence; प्रियस्य सुहृदो यत्र मम तत्रैव संभवो भूयात् <ls>Māl. 9</ls>; मानुषीषु कथं वा स्यादस्य रूपस्य संभवः <ls>Ś. 1. 26</ls>; अन्नाद्भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसंभवः <ls>Bg. 3. 14</ls>; <ab>oft.</ab> at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> in this sense; अप्सरःसंभवैषा <ls>Ś. 1</ls>. .²2 Production and bringing up; यं मातापितरौ क्लेशं सहेते संभवे नृणाम् <ls>Ms. 2. 227</ls>; (see <ls>Kull.</ls> thereon). .²3 Cause, origin, motive. .²4 Mixing, union, combination. .²5 Possibility; संयोगो हि वियोगस्य संसूचयति संभवम् <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²6 Compatibility, consistency. .²7 Adaptation, appropriateness. .²8 Agreement, conformity. .²9 Capacity. .²10 Equivalence (one of the Pramāṇas). .²11 Acquaintance. .²12 Loss, destruction. .²13 (In <ab>rhet.</ab>) A possible case. .²14 Cohabitation. .²15 (<ab>pl.</ab>) Wealth, prosperity; स सर्वभयनिर्मुक्तः संभवानधितिष्ठति <ls>Mb. 13. 64. 11</ls>. .²16 Knowledge (विद्या); अन्यदेवाहुः संभवादन्यदाहुरसंभवात् <ls>Īśop. 13</ls>. .²17 Occurrence, appearance.
